objective: Implement deck construction, draw/discard mechanics, and an effect resolution pipeline integrated with combat.

steps.title: Design data model mapping
steps.description: Review card schema and ensure C# data models match schema properties.

steps.title: Implement core deck & hand types
steps.description: Create Deck, Hand, DrawPile, DiscardPile classes and ICard/ICardEffect interfaces.

steps.title: Build draw/discard mechanics
steps.description: Implement Draw, Discard, Shuffle with events and pooling.

steps.title: Create effect resolution pipeline
steps.description: Design and implement ResolveTargeting, ApplyCosts, ApplyEffects, PostResolve phases.

steps.title: Integrate with Combat System
steps.description: Define contracts and adapters between card effects and combat actions.

steps.title: Editor tools & import
steps.description: Add JSON import and conversion tool for ScriptableObjects.

steps.title: Tests & validation
steps.description: Add unit tests for core mechanics and effect resolution.
